verdict.rationale: Groq is an API platform, and such a platform could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers OpenAI-compatible REST APIs, a server-side TypeScript SDK, an llms.txt file and an MCP server, but never mentions an official command-line tool. SDK libraries are developer building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
